$Comment: What the party sees the moment the Blight Warden rises to bar the Heartwood Gate: the big
banner, its title and its line underneath. The Warden's binding row points its Engaged beat here
words belong to this one fight and no other encounter borrows them.
The moment fires once per member of the fight. The banner is kept to the world the fight is in
(SameWorldOnly, and a chase round has a world of its own), always reaches the members themselves
(ToParticipants), and shows once a minute per fight however many members fire it
(MinSecondsBetween), so every survivor sees it exactly once. Add a Toast group for a quieter
notice beside the banner, or a Sound for a sting; the round's own dread music keeps playing
